title: Will the world pass 2 degrees Celsius over pre-industrial levels before 2050?
rules: If the annual global mean surface temperature anomaly has reached or exceeded +2.0°C above pre-industrial levels (1850-1900 average) in any calendar year before Jan 1, 2050, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: When will nuclear fusion be achieved?
rules: If nuclear fusion is achieved before Jan 1, 2030, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: When will nuclear fusion be achieved?
rules: If nuclear fusion is achieved before Jan 1, 2035, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will humans colonize Mars before 2050?
rules: If humans have a self-sufficient colony of at least 10 people residing on Mars for at least one Earth year before Jan 1, 2050, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Which country will be the next to send humans to the Moon?
rules: If China is the first country to launch a manned mission to the Moon before Jan 1, 2031, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will any company announce that it has achieved Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) before Jan 1, 2031?
rules: If any company (public or private) officially announces that it has achieved Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) after market issuance and before Jan 1, 2031, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the U.S. confirm that aliens exist before Jan 20, 2029?
rules: If the President, any member of the Cabinet, any member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, or any US federal agency definitively states that extraterrestrial life or technology exists before Jan 20, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Pandemic by Dec 31, 2029?
rules: If the WHO identifies any disease as a pandemic after issuance and by Dec 31, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: When will the first useful quantum computer be developed?
rules: If a quantum computer cracks 2048-bit RSA encryption using Shor's algorithm, or accurately simulates either the nitrogenase FeMo cofactor or cytochrome P450 enzyme before Jan 1, 2030, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: When will the first useful quantum computer be developed?
rules: If a quantum computer cracks 2048-bit RSA encryption using Shor's algorithm, or accurately simulates either the nitrogenase FeMo cofactor or cytochrome P450 enzyme before Jan 1, 2035, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: AI regulation by 2028?
rules: If a bill becomes law regulating AI by Jan 1, 2028 (ET), then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will independent AI safety audits become U.S. law before Jan 1, 2028?
rules: If federal legislation requiring independent AI safety evaluations or audits has become law after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028 (ET), then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the House pass a bill regulating AI in political ads?
rules: If a bill regulating AI in political ads has passed the House after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028 (ET), then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the compound annual growth rate in U.S. nonfarm business labor productivity between the annual observations for 2026 and 2031 be above 2.5% per year?
rules: If the compound annual growth rate in U.S. nonfarm business labor productivity between the annual observations for 2026 and 2031 is above 2.5% per year, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will it be reported by any of the Source Agencies that the governments of the United States and China have signed a new agreement containing a specific commitment on artificial intelligence before Jan 1, 2027?
rules: If the governments of the United States and China have signed a new agreement containing a specific commitment on artificial intelligence after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027 (ET), then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Tesla Optimus on sale before 2028?
rules: If the Tesla Optimus (or another humanoid robot) is on sale to the general public before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the FDA approve VERVE-102 before Jan 1, 2032?
rules: If the FDA approves VERVE-102 for marketing before Jan 1, 2032, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will OpenAI or Anthropic announces it has achieved recursive self-improvement before Jan 1, 2029?
rules: If OpenAI or Anthropic announces it has achieved recursive self-improvement before Jan 1, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.

title: Will the US commit to a national AI regulator before Jan 1, 2028?
rules: If the United States agrees to or announces the establishment of a national AI regulator after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028 (ET), then the market resolves to Yes.
